result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers show all 12 months in order, with bars starting from zero, and both make May clearly the peak. A labels every bar with its exact value, but its y-axis labels are clipped at the left edge, and it highlights May in a second color, which goes slightly against the one-color request. B keeps a single bar color with a plain title and readable axis ticks, so it fits 'simple, nothing fancy' a little better, though its dark background is an odd choice for a newsletter. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B prints a dollar label on every bar and makes the May peak stand out with a light accent color. Its weak points are that the left edges of the y-axis labels are clipped and the title is a headline rather than a plain one. A is clean and simple, but only May is labeled, so you have to estimate the other months from the $10k gridlines, and its dark background is an odd fit for a garden newsletter.
